reviews.title: Seaplane
reviews.text: I may be roughly 6-5 years late, but I just recently watched both of the Jumanji movies for the first time ever and I downloaded this app to continue the fun. To my disbelief, the game doesn’t include Nick Jonas’ character Jefferson “Seaplane” McDonough, which happens to be my favorite character from both movies. I really love the game, and it’s really fun to play even after unlocking all the areas, but the one thing that really bugs me and grinds my gears is the exclusion of Seaplane. If the developers made an update to include him I’d definitely bump up my 4 stars to 5

reviews.text: It’s unacceptable to have to be constantly inundated with ads AND there haven’t been any updates, challenges won’t unlock or there aren’t any game rules that tell you how to unlock them. I also tried to pay for no ads but basically just flushed my money down the toilet because the ads didn’t stop and they didn’t appear to decrease either. At the very least, this deceptive option needs to be removed.
